---
name: Bug report
about: Report reproducible CLI, discovery, installation or documentation problems
title: "Bug: "
---

## Environment

- CLI revision, OS/distribution, CPU architecture, Bash and Python versions:
- Receiver model, region and firmware (or clearly labeled simulation):
- Explicit host, SSDP or cache resolution? VPN active?

## Reproduction and result

Commands, expected result, actual result and exit code. Start with read-only
queries. Do not reproduce with loud volume, destructive raw commands or reset.

## Redacted diagnostics

Review debug output before posting. Remove addresses, UDN/serials, private room
names, usernames, machine paths and credentials. Never paste the complete cache.

## Scope

MODEL 40n is the only developer-tested hardware. Does this report describe a
physical owner observation, vendor documentation, or a simulation? Silence is
Unknown and is not proof that a receiver feature is unsupported.
